how.lead: Forecasting means making a clear forecast before the outcome is known. Creators start the conversation. You make your own call, explain why, and revisit it as events unfold.

steps.title: Explore the question
steps.body: Discover a question that interests you. Explore a creator’s forecast and the reasoning behind it.

steps.title: Make your forecast
steps.body: Name the outcome you expect before the reveal, result or announcement. Make an independent call.

steps.title: Explain your thinking
steps.body: Share the clues and arguments behind your forecast. Discuss different views and consider what could change your mind.

steps.title: Follow the outcome
steps.body: Return when the answer is known. Compare it with your forecast, reflect on your reasoning, and learn for the next one.
